en.io: Inputs raw JWT tokens along with target HTTP request headers, and outputs vulnerability identification, misconfiguration details, or re-signed tokens.
en.boundary: This skill provides testing methodology and analysis guidance, but does not perform automated full exploitation or fix vulnerable code.
scenarios: Auditing web or mobile applications for JWT authentication bypasses and misconfigurations
Exploiting algorithm confusion (RS256 to HS256) or algorithm bypasses (alg:none)
Testing for header injection vulnerabilities like SQL injection, path traversal, or SSRF via kid and jku parameters

zh.io: 输入原始 JWT 令牌及目标 HTTP 请求标头，输出漏洞识别结果、配置缺陷细节或重新签名的令牌。
zh.boundary: 本技能仅提供测试方法学和分析指导，不进行自动化的全量漏洞利用或修复脆弱代码。
scenarios: 审计 Web 或移动应用中的 JWT 身份验证绕过与安全配置缺陷
利用算法混淆（RS256 切换为 HS256）或算法绕过（alg:none）进行越权测试
通过 kid、jku、jwk 等标头参数注入测试 SQL 注入、路径穿越或 SSRF 漏洞
